basics.name: Igor Rybakov
basics.label: Senior Frontend / Fullstack Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer working on enterprise applications, GIS, financial and healthcare systems since 2018. Focused on Angular, TypeScript, frontend architecture and performance. Led five developers and independently developed and operated a B2B platform spanning frontend, backend, infrastructure and integrations.

work.name: VS Industrie GmbH
work.summary: Sole responsibility for development and operation of Spairtech, a technical platform for an industrial equipment distributor.
highlights: Designed and built a CRM from scratch, unifying customers, orders, catalog, communications, telephony and email campaigns; replaced legacy software and fragmented Excel workflows.
Built and launched a B2B website and catalog, covering frontend, backend, data modeling, search, SEO, CRM integration and deployment.
Built an agentic AI pipeline to generate product pages from technical documentation.
Developed a pilot AI voice operator using streaming ASR, VAD/barge-in, an LLM, text-to-speech and CRM reporting.
Integrated Asterisk/FreePBX into the CRM, linking calls to customers and providing interaction history, notes and a database-generated phone book.
Connected GoIP gateways and SIM cards from different countries and configured routing with local numbers for customers in Germany and Russia.
Built templated email campaigns personalized with CRM data for marketing and reactivation.
Added a read-only AI assistant for customer search, interaction history analysis and email drafting.
Modernized infrastructure by retiring an obsolete PBX and redundant server, simplifying the network and replacing OpenVPN with WireGuard. More than halved infrastructure costs.
Independently operated PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, Docker, Linux, CI/CD, networking and integrations.

work.name: Big3 / A.PRO
work.summary: Development of an enterprise GIS platform for environmental operations and logistics.
highlights: Led five developers, covering task estimation and allocation, performance reviews, mentoring and delivery of team tasks.
Reduced rendering time for a map with 100,000 markers from 3.5 seconds to 200 ms by separating monolithic logic into independent layers.
Developed a Rust/WASM client-side cache in a browser worker with IndexedDB, adaptive batching, delta synchronization and local filtering.
Reduced average dashboard CPU utilization during database access from 120% to 80% under comparable workload through client-side caching and filtering.
Following the Terminal refactor, reported blocker and critical bugs decreased from 61 in H2 2024 to 27 in H1 2025.
Moved Terminal form configuration from hardcoded templates to an admin panel, saving an average of 2–3 hours per relevant task across development, testing, regression checks and deployment.
Reduced Terminal response time from 3 seconds to 0.3 seconds in load testing.
Worked with a colleague to modularize electronic signing, separating NCALayer and CryptoPro into provider integrations.
Unified geoservice APIs through a common integration layer supporting multiple providers.
Built tools for monitoring, adding and moderating vehicle trackers, with authorization, filters and tables.
Adapted a legacy application for mobile devices and tablets.
Extended document workflows with batch signing, reconciliation and bulk route transfers.
Created a reusable component-based UI architecture configurable for different customers.
Developed map-based visual analytics and contributed to Python/Django backend filtering and bug fixes.
Introduced project and code documentation for developers, analysts, implementation and QA teams.
Contributed to frontend technical requirements and task planning for a contract in Kazakhstan.
Promoted performance-focused development and helped define QA metrics.

work.name: Rosbank
work.summary: MVP dashboard for monitoring currencies and stock market indices.
highlights: Developed an MVP currency and index monitoring dashboard with configurable block layouts and interface elements.
Built a subscription system with user-defined formulas, triggers and reusable settings.
Implemented configurable windows, menus and workspaces.

work.name: SmartDeal
work.summary: Frontend development for a real estate transaction automation product.
highlights: Owned the frontend of the entire product as its sole frontend developer.
Built document generation for real estate transactions with 17 document types and customizable templates.
Implemented SMS-based electronic signing.
Implemented application status monitoring and data updates.
Worked on a product subsequently acquired by CIAN and PSB.

work.name: LANIT-TERCOM
work.summary: Development of data visualization and GIS platforms.
highlights: Contributed to a data visualization platform using Angular and NgRx.
Added end-to-end testing with Cypress.
Developed a GIS date-handling module for planning, visualization and analytics.

work.name: Freelance
work.summary: MVP application with an interactive map for a civic campaign in the Komi Republic.
highlights: Built an MVP in three days with an interactive map, voting and feedback; deployed ASP.NET Core, MS SQL and Angular/Ionic, then handed the system to the customer for launch.

work.name: ETAI
work.summary: Development of an EMR/EHR platform and eTIME, a project management application.
highlights: Built interactive SVG anatomy maps with predefined regions and medical labels, replacing manual drawing and labeling by clinicians.
Developed a C# scanning service on .NET Framework 4.5: a WebSocket devices command listed scanners, while scan with a device ID returned a base64 image to the browser.
Developed SQL scripts for updating medication data and ICD-10/ICD-11 classifications.
Built the eTIME frontend from scratch, including registration, boards, tasks, comments, profiles and workspaces.
Implemented task update synchronization through WebSocket/SignalR and workspace onboarding through email invitations.
